description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: The Falcons placed Trey Sermon on the injured reserve on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sermon has landed on the IR after being signed by Atlanta just over a week ago, and the exact reasoning is unknown. The running back had one carry for three yards in the team's preseason opener last week.
items.title: Trey Sermon placed on injured reserve

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: The New York Giants claimed Ben Barten off waivers on Wednesday.
items.impact: Barten is already in his second stint with the Giants after going undrafted in the 2026 NFL Draft. The defensive tackle will look to earn a spot on the roster before training camp ends.
items.title: Ben Barten claimed by Giants

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: The Miami Dolphins released Zane Gonzalez on Wednesday.
items.impact: Gonzalez will now hit the open market after he was placed on the injured reserve last week. Riley Patterson is now the lone kicker on the Miami roster at this point in training camp.
items.title: Zane Gonzalez released by Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns say RB Quinshon Judkins is not at practice on Wednesday due to a "minor issue."
items.impact: It is unclear what Judkins is dealing with specifically. It doesn't appear to be a serious concern.
items.title: Quinshon Judkins not at practice Wednesday due to 'minor issue'

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Keenan Allen will begin practicing with the Colts on Thursday.
items.impact: Allen agreed to a contract with the Colts earlier this week. He'll add depth to a depleted Colts wide receiver room.
items.title: Keenan Allen to begin practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DJ Giddens left practice early on Wednesday with an apparent hamstring injury.
items.impact: Giddens was working his way back from a previous hamstring injury, so it appears he may have aggravated his previous injury.
items.title: DJ Giddens (hamstring) exits early Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Warren left practice early on Wednesday with an apparent injury.
items.impact: It is being reported as a groin injury for Warren. He left with an athletic trainer and returned to the sideline without a helmet. There should be an update on his official status when available.
items.title: Tyler Warren leaves practice early Wednesday

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: Will Howard is set to start in preseason Week 2 against the Jets.
items.impact: Howard completed 7-of-9 passes for 86 yards in last week's preseason game. His fantasy value currently remains limited to dynasty formats, making it somewhat notable that he's playing over Drew Allar.
items.title: Will Howard will start on Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carnell Tate did not practice on Wednesday due to stiffness.
items.impact: It doesn't about to be a serious concern. Tate is day-to-day heading into Thursday.
items.title: Carnell Tate misses practice due to stiffness

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. is expected to be good to go for the start of the season.
items.impact: Pittman has a minor hamstring injury that has held him out for a week and a half. He has no concerns for Week 1.
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (hamstring) expected to be ready for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers WR DK Metcalf is expected to be good to go for Week 1.
items.impact: Metcalf has been sidelined from practice with an undisclosed injury. It has kept him out the last week and a half.
items.title: DK Metcalf expected to be ready for Week 1

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers will not play against the Jets in Week 2 of the preseason.
items.impact: Rodgers has rarely played in the preseason over the past decade, and that trend may continue as he enters his age-42 season as the Steelers' QB1.
items.title: Aaron Rodgers will not play Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: CB Trevon Diggs is signing a one-year deal with the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Diggs worked out for Seattle earlier this week. He will add depth in the corner back room for the Seahawks.
items.title: Trevon Diggs signs one-year deal with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said the starters will not play on Thursday against the Raiders.
items.impact: Ryans feels he saw enough during Tuesday's practice. They should see some reps in the third and final preseason game.
items.title: C.J. Stroud, Texans starters not playing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell made it clear that J.J. MCCarthy is the Vikings' No. 2 QB.
items.impact: O'Connell added that he wants the room to remain competitive and did not rule out further consideration. Kyler Murray was named the starter.
items.title: J.J. McCarthy confirmed to be Vikings QB2

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mitchell Trubisky returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Trubisky was being evaluated for a bicep injury to open the week. He is competing for the backup role.
items.title: Mitchell Trubisky (bicep) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tristan Wirfs returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wirfs sustained a hamstring injury during the first week of Bucs training camp. He remains on track to be good to go for the start of the season.
items.title: Tristan Wirfs (hamstring) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans signed RB D'Ernest Johnson.
items.impact: Johnson will add depth in the backfield for Tennessee.
items.title: D'Ernest Johnson signs with Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars acquired G Daniel Faalele from the Giants in exchange for a late 2027 draft pick.
items.impact: Faalele signed with the Giants in April. He'll add depth on the offensive line for Jacksonville.
items.title: Daniel Faalele traded to Jaguars

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Eagles DC Vic Fangio said Jonathan Greenard could miss Week 1 against the Commanders.
items.impact: Greenard injured his pec in late July. He is hopeful to return later in August, but his status for the start of the season remains up in the air.
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (pec) could miss Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Makai Lemon remained absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lemon has been sidelined for nearly two weeks with the hamstring issue. It remains unclear when he will return to practice.
items.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) still not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tank Bigsby returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bigsby missed some practice time with the toe issue. He is slated to open the season backing up Saquon Barkley.
items.title: Tank Bigsby (toe) returns to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chargers C Tyler Biadasz is out indefinitely with a knee injury.
items.impact: Biadasz had to be carted off during the team's joint practice with the 49ers. It is possible he misses the entire season.
items.title: Tyler Biadasz (knee) out indefinitely

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tony Pollard returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pollard missed two practices with a foot issue. He saw four carries in the Titans preseason opener.
items.title: Tony Pollard (foot) returns to practice Wednesday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jayden Higgins (knee) suffered a torn ACL in practice on Tuesday. He is now out for the 2026 NFL season.
items.impact: Higgins was having a great training camp by all reports, so this is awful news for those who invested in him for fantasy. But even moreso for the player, who was looking to have a second year breakout, and now must turn his attention to the 2027 season. Tank Dell and Jaylin Noel will likely see the largest uptick in work in his absence with Xavier Hutchinson still coming in as more of a blocking receiver.
items.title: Jayden Higgins (knee) suffers torn ACL, out for 2026
